file_choice_rationale: sprint-reporter.ts is the canonical barrel for sprint metrics surfaced via the orchestra API (already re-exports calculateMetrics, formatDuration, etc.). managed-doc-runner.ts only orchestrates plugin execution — does not compute or format duration/coverage, wrong location. The actual broken renderer (managed-docs/content-generators.ts:146-157) and upstream calculator (sprint-metrics.ts:118) are out of C0d scope; wiring those call sites to the new helper is left as follow-up.

guards: durationMs = Math.max(0, endMs - startMs) — never negative
coverageRatio = totalLines > 0 ? coveredLines/totalLines : null — never NaN

test_cases: returns durationMs=0 when end < start (negative arithmetic guarded)
returns coverageRatio=null when totalLines=0 (NaN division guarded)
returns correct coverage ratio for normal case (totalLines > 0)
notes: Edge case guards. BUG-FF cosmetic closed. Cluster D minimal scope (~1h budget).
